Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Examine a campsite for ten minutes to find its hazards and shelter. Use that shelter to give your group 1 Boon against weather and exposure.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
Ten minutes of examination.
Target / range / shape
One campsite you can examine.
Type
Skill / Utility

After examining the site, learn the environmental dangers that the site currently presents and an available way to shelter from each. When your party makes camp using that shelter, you and up to six companions gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls against weather and exposure while that camp remains in use.
